family_name: Higgins Insulation Higgins Polyester Sound Control Batt

spec.description:
Polyester Sound Control Batts are high-density acoustic
insulation slabs specifically engineered to reduce unwanted noise transfer
through internal walls, mid-floors, and ceilings in residential homes. Acting
like an acoustic sponge, they absorb sound reflections and vibrations to prevent
speech, television, and bathroom plumbing noise from traveling between rooms.
Available in 11 kg/m³ and 14 kg/m³ densities across 50mm and 75mm thicknesses,
they are 100% polyester, itch-free, non-toxic, and tested to AS/NZS 1530.3.

install:
Turn off power at the main
switchboard before working near electrical cables

Select batt width (450mm
or 600mm) matching wall stud centers

Squeeze and friction-fit batts between
timber or steel wall studs ensuring snug contact

Ensure batts butt tightly
against top and bottom plates with no air gaps

Cut neatly around electrical
boxes, plumbing, and cables using a sharp serrated knife

Do not compress
batts beyond cavity depth to maintain acoustic absorption

Fasten acoustic
plasterboard directly over studs to complete acoustic wall system
selection_checklist: Select cavity thickness (50mm for 70mm studs; 75mm for 90mm studs)

Choose
density (11 kg/m³ for standard noise; 14 kg/m³ for higher acoustic
attenuation)
Calculate required square meterage from wall dimensions
limitations:
Internal wall and ceiling cavity use only; not for direct
weather exposure

Does not replace structural mass; combine with dense
plasterboard for maximum acoustic Rw

Maintain required clearances around
non-IC rated light fittings
